Not quite yet. The summary captures what we approved, but a few important first-version behaviors are missing:

- I need a clearly separate **Delete permanently** action. Archive must remain reversible; deletion should require confirmation and remove the link for good.
- For a large library, I need to select several links—or every link matching the current view, search, and tag filters—and then add/remove tags, mark read/unread, archive, or delete them together.
- Clicking an entry’s title should open the original page.
- Along with the title, description, and icon, saving should collect the page’s preview image when one is available, even if the calm list doesn’t always display it.

Please add those to the settled first-version scope. With those included, you may begin building the real application.
